backend/src/main/java/com/visionary/rost.purpose: Serves as the main entry point for the Visionary Roster Spring Boot application. This class bootstraps the entire application context by invoking SpringApplication.run() with the primary configuration class, enabling auto-configuration and component scanning for the roster management system.

functions.purpose: Application entry point that launches the Spring Boot application by delegating to SpringApplication.run() with the VisApplication class and command-line arguments.

backend/src/main/java/com/visionary/rost.purpose: Provides REST API endpoints for authentication operations in the roster management system. Terminates the current user session and logs the logout event with correlation tracking.
Retrieves the current authenticated user's session information including user ID and facility ID.

backend/src/main/java/com/visionary/rost.purpose: Defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for user login requests in the roster management system. Encapsulates username, password, and facility ID with validation constraints to ensure all required authentication fields are provided before processing.

backend/src/main/java/com/visionary/rost.purpose: Defines a standardized error response Data Transfer Object (DTO) for the roster management system. This class encapsulates comprehensive error information including correlation tracking, error codes, messages, remediation guidance, timestamps, HTTP status codes, and field-level validation errors for API responses.

Configures Spring Security for the Roster application, defining authentication and authorization rules for REST API endpoints. Establishes session management policies, role-based access control for staff management operations, and disables CSRF protection for stateless API interactions.

functions.signature: public SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception
functions.purpose: Configures the security filter chain with CSRF disabled, session management settings, endpoint authorization rules based on roles (MANAGER, STAFF), and exception handling for unauthorized access.
Provides a BCrypt password encoder bean for secure password hashing and validation throughout the application.

backend/src/main/java/com/visionary/rost.purpose: Implements a servlet filter that manages correlation IDs for distributed tracing across HTTP requests. Extracts or generates a unique correlation ID from incoming requests, stores it in the SLF4J MDC context for logging, and ensures it is propagated in the response header for end-to-end request tracking.

functions.signature: public void doFilter(ServletRequest request, ServletResponse response, FilterChain chain) throws IOException, ServletException
functions.purpose: Intercepts HTTP requests to extract or generate a correlation ID, stores it in the MDC logging context, adds it to the response header, and ensures cleanup after request processing completes.

backend/src/main/java/com/visionary/rost.purpose: Defines the contract for emitting audit events in the roster management system. Provides a standardized interface for publishing audit trails of staff updates, deactivations, and generic auditable actions to audit logging or event streaming infrastructure with correlation ID support for distributed tracing.

functions.signature: void emitStaffUpdateEvent(Long staffId, Long userId, Map<String, Object> changes)
functions.purpose: Emits an audit event when staff information is updated, capturing the staff ID, user performing the update, and a map of changed fields with their new values.

functions.signature: void emitStaffDeactivateEvent(Long staffId, Long userId, String reason)
functions.purpose: Emits an audit event when a staff member is deactivated, recording the staff ID, user performing the action, and the reason for deactivation for compliance and accountability.

functions.signature: void emitAuditEvent(String eventType, String entityType, Long entityId, Long userId, Map<String, Object> metadata)
functions.purpose: Emits a generic audit event for any auditable action in the system, providing flexibility for custom events with automatic correlation ID inclusion for end-to-end request tracing.

backend/src/main/java/com/visionary/rost.purpose: Defines a custom runtime exception for handling inactive user account scenarios in the roster management system. Encapsulates the user ID associated with the inactive account to provide context for exception handling and logging.

Returns the user ID associated with the inactive account exception for downstream error handling and auditing.

backend/src/main/java/com/visionary/rost.purpose: Provides centralized exception handling for the Roster application using Spring's @RestControllerAdvice. Intercepts various exception types (validation errors, authentication failures, access denials, resource not found) and transforms them into standardized ErrorResponse objects with correlation IDs, error codes, HTTP status codes, and remediation guidance for API consumers.

functions.purpose: Handles validation errors from request body validation, extracts field-level errors, and returns a 422 UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY response with detailed field error mappings.
Handles invalid login credentials and returns a 401 UNAUTHORIZED response with guidance to verify credentials.
Handles attempts to access the system with an inactive account and returns a 403 FORBIDDEN response with instructions to contact an administrator.
Handles forbidden access attempts when users lack permissions for specific resources or facilities and returns a 403 FORBIDDEN response with contextual logging.
Handles cases where requested resources cannot be found, formats resource type and ID information, and returns a 404 NOT_FOUND response.
Handles illegal argument exceptions from invalid request parameters and returns a 400 BAD_REQUEST response.
Handles JPA entity not found exceptions and returns a 404 NOT_FOUND response with generic resource not found messaging.
Handles Spring Security authentication failures and returns a 401 UNAUTHORIZED response prompting users to log in.
Handles Spring Security access denied exceptions when authenticated users lack required permissions and returns a 403 FORBIDDEN response.
Catches all unhandled exceptions as a fallback, logs full stack traces, and returns a 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR response with a correlation ID for support tracking.

backend/src/main/java/com/visionary/rost.purpose: Custom exception class for resource not found scenarios in the roster management system. Captures resource type and ID metadata for detailed error reporting.

functions.purpose: Constructs a new ResourceNotFoundException with a custom detail message for generic resource not found scenarios.

Returns the type of resource that was not found.
Returns the ID of the resource that was not found.
